text:
Jess (CS): Heads up — AcmeCorp says their promo codes (ACME50) are getting \"promo_invalid: expired\" when applied via the API. ~30 customers hit it in the last hour.

Maria G.: Which campaign id? any sample request/response?

Jess (CS): campaign_id=camp_44X9. Example from customer: 
```
POST /v1/promos/apply
{
  \"code\": \"ACME50\",
  \"user_id\": \"u_123\"
}
```
Response: 
```
422 {\"error\":\"promo_invalid\", \"reason\":\"expired\"}
```

Sachin P.: grabbing logs and the campaign row now. pinging import owner.

billing-bot: webhook event for apply_attempt id=req_78f, campaign=camp_44X9, promo_applied=false, reason=expired, campaign_start=2025-04-06T00:00:00Z, campaign_end=2025-04-10T23:59:59Z

Maria G.: Marketing says they uploaded a CSV with start/end as "04/06/2025 - 10/06/2025" (they meant DD/MM = 4 June to 10 June). The import tool parsed dates using MM/DD and turned those into April 6–10. But customer expects it active now (June).

Sachin P.: Confirmed in DB: camp_44X9.start=2025-04-06, end=2025-04-10. The marketing CSV used DD/MM. In this case the importer silently accepted ambiguous dates and stored wrong values. That makes the campaign appear \"expired\" for June clients.

Tyler (Billing): Noted. We have ~32 apply attempts from today that failed and 8 paying customers impacted. We should both (A) make campaign active now and (B) grant credits to affected users.

Jess (CS): Agreed. Recommended immediate steps?

Sachin P.: Remediation plan (short):
1) Manual fix: update DB campaign dates to the intended values (2025-06-04 -> 2025-06-10). I'll prepare a safe migration and audit.
2) Grant credits to the affected users via internal grants endpoint (see curl below).
3) Hotfix importer to reject ambiguous date formats and add a UI preview showing parsed dates.
4) Add validation in campaign creation: if end < start, fail the import and surface the parsed ISO dates in the UI.

Jess (CS): Curl for credits (use admin token):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/grants \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"user_id\":\"u_123\",\"amount_cents\":5000,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"reason\":\"promo-misconfig: ACME50 apology\"}'
```

Maria G.: Also propose: automatic preview diff email to marketing showing parsed start/end + timezone. This would have prevented the misunderstanding.

Sachin P.: Repro steps for eng to test importer:
- create CSV row with start_date=04/06/2025 (intended DD/MM)
- run importer with current parser (US locale) -> observe stored 2025-04-06
- run importer with stricter ISO parser -> should reject or parse as 2025-06-04

Jess (CS): I'll notify AcmeCorp that we're rolling a fix and will credit affected customers. Suggested customer message: short apology + confirmation of credit and that the campaign will be active immediately.

Tyler (Billing): I'll draft the compensation amounts and approve the grants.

Maria G.: Postmortem items: importer validation, UI preview, detect mixed-format rows, and a migration script to surface all campaigns created via CSV in the last 90 days for manual review.

Sachin P.: Working on the migration patch now. Will post the PR and the DB update plan in #eng-infra. Expect a short downtime window for writes to campaign table if needed.

Jess (CS): :thumbsup: Please ping here when done so CS can close the loop with AcmeCorp.

billing-bot: processed grant request queue: queued 8 grants for manual approval (req_batch=bn_2025_06_04)

Jess (CS): Thanks all — I'll send the customer note after grants are confirmed.
